note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-g-kill: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route G, kill (brief 013 D; Motive 013 §6.1 G-kill): route G with a kill (3 s) instead of a knockout; the body is carried at a walk to the Office's service door and put through it (10 s, off-screen), the Dumpster beside it being emptied at 5:22. Nobody sees the act or the carry; the 4:00 mark is missed (Alert 1) and at Alert 1 nobody opens the door. In the debrief the guard is a missing person: +2 T, no Menace, his lover's worry, +1 guard and +1 camera on the block for 3 missions, and an open case. Brief 023 (Waymark, 2026-10-19; engine 0.8.2 crowd.pace): guard 74 (p-records-office-74) walks from the café round the Office's north-east corner and past the service lane at 4:33, on the escort's line, and sees the carry within near-m 3 m (Alert 2 at 4:20 when the Enforcer went in at 3:30). The careful player waits at the public door and goes in at 4:04, so Vale comes out at 4:42 with 74 6 m south of the lane and walking away: nobody sees the escort (A 1, 2 T, Standing +3 with the fight), 34 s slower than going in at once.
